thesis.text: Glenstone's cash offer for AIRE has become unconditional at 70.0p/share and the AIRE Board now recommends acceptance despite viewing it as undervaluing NAV by ~17%, since Glenstone has secured voting control [uk:9762692]. With no competing bid and settlement due within 14 days, the near-term trade is essentially resolved cash arbitrage; remaining minority holders face a multi-year managed wind-down under a controlling shareholder with governance, liquidity and delisting risks [uk:9762692]. Monitor for the closing notice, settlement confirmation, and any post-completion actions (board changes, delisting to TISE) as they will define residual holder outcomes.
